name: Heritage Bakery
address: plot 8 farm 191, rondevlei,, Wilderness, South Africa
description_short: Farm bakery serving fresh breads, pastries, and café fare in a rustic Wilderness setting with a petting zoo.
description_long:
Tucked away on a working farm between Wilderness and Sedgefield, Heritage Bakery brings an authentic farm-to-table experience to the Garden Route. The smell of freshly baked sourdough and pastries greets you as you arrive, while kids can meet the resident farm animals in the petting zoo. The bakery counter is stocked with artisan breads, decadent cakes, and savoury pies, all made on-site using traditional methods.

Settle into the rustic café space for breakfast or lunch, where the menu leans into wholesome, home-style cooking. Think farm-fresh eggs, generous sandwiches on house-baked bread, and hearty salads. The coffee is excellent, and the relaxed pace makes it easy to linger. It's a proper farm experience — unpretentious, welcoming, and genuinely connected to the land around it.
